sloka: रथमास्थाय विपुलं तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः ।मेघाभो मेघवर्णश्च मेघस्वनमहास्वनः ।राक्षसैः संवृतो भीमैस्तदा निर्यात्यकम्पनः ।। ६.५५.७ ।।।।
transliteration: rathamāsthāya vipulaṁ taptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ ।meghābho meghavarṇaśca meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ ।rākṣasaiḥ saṁvṛto bhīmaistadā niryātyakampanaḥ ।। 6.55.7 ।।।।

translations.english: Mounted on a huge chariot, Akampana, decked in pure gold jewels, like cloud in form and complexion, whose loud voice resembled thunder, surrounded by Rakshasas went forward.
